sentence_1_it: Noi abbiamo tutti riso alla sua battuta.
sentence_1_en: We all laughed at his joke.
sentence_2_it: Tom l'ha intesa come battuta, però nessuno ha riso.
sentence_2_en: Tom meant it as a joke, but nobody laughed.
sentence_3_it: Questa battuta non ha niente a che fare con lei.
sentence_3_en: This joke doesn't have anything to do with you.

sentence_1_en: It's okay if you laugh at your own jokes. It annoys me when Tom does, but that's because he isn't very funny.
sentence_2_it: Le sue battute ci hanno fatto ridere.

sentence_1_en: He isn't appreciative of my little jokes.
